paper: Tian et al., Adv Mater 2026, Fig 1d
grid: 3 cholesterol tails (B1,B2,B3) x 17 cores (5 commercial + 12 synthesized C1-C6 x O1/O2)
method: printed numerals; glyph connected components, binarized and aspect-preserved, complete-linkage clustered on Jaccard distance

independent_colourbar_check.what: cell fill mapped through the continuous white-to-blue bar (0-3e6), independent of the glyphs. Saturates below ~1e5, so it checks the large values and rank order, not the small ones.
